_about: Public-domain Alfred Edersheim (1825-1889, Hebrew Christian scholar, Church of England) for the Word Hoard: The Temple, its Ministry and Services and Sketches of Jewish Social Life from CCEL (Hodder and Stoughton, 1904), and from Internet Archive scans The Life and Times of Jesus the Messiah (two volumes, second edition, 1884), the seven-volume Bible History (Religious Tract Society, 1875-1887), History of the Jewish Nation (1856), The Golden Diary (1866), Elisha the Prophet, Prophecy and History in relation to the Messiah (1885) and Jesus the Messiah (1890). Raw OCR for the scans. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 21 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
